catalog.description: The caster releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of caster's health.
catalog.differences: AI: Prioritize cast on allies with missing health.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Performs an instant attack and applies a basic dispel and Solar Crests on every unit hit. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
catalog.name: Mist Coil
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: Hits in 1000 AOE around target and doesn't hurt caster.

catalog.description: Empowers the hero's attacks, causing their attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
catalog.name: Moon Glaives
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: -8% damage reduction per bounce. +1 bounces.

catalog.description: The caster launches a barrage of firespit globs over 5.5 seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. The caster has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of 600.
catalog.name: Mortimer Kisses
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: +20% slow, and +20 burn damage per second. Given Gobble Up ability.

catalog.description: Channeling. Releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying longer duration Frost Arrows. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.
catalog.differences: Applies all attack modifiers -- not just Frost Arrows.
catalog.name: Multishot

catalog.description: The caster uses their ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to their adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over 2.2 seconds.
catalog.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Increases total damage by 450 and causes damage to no longer split between enemies.
catalog.name: Mystic Flare
catalog.superUpgrade: Super: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 700 range. Heroes will take priority.
